title: Indoor Air Quality Alert
dataSources: Weather-station observations (`ecowitt:obs`, `weatherflow:obs`), air-quality readings (`purpleair:aqi`, `airgradient:sensor`), soil/greenhouse sensors, aquarium controllers.
app: Personal weather stations (Ecowitt/Ambient/Davis/WeatherFlow), air-quality sensors (PurpleAir/AirGradient), and aquarium/greenhouse/soil sensors via HEC and MQTT.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=airgradient:sensor
| stats latest(pm25) as pm25, latest(co2_ppm) as co2, latest(voc_index) as voc by location
| eval concern=case(pm25>35,"high particulates",co2>1000,"stuffy air",voc>250,"high VOCs",1=1,"good")
| where concern!="good"
description: Watches indoor air-quality sensors for high particulates, stale carbon dioxide, or volatile chemicals and tells you which room needs a window open.
value: Poor indoor air harms sleep and focus in ways you cannot feel; a per-room alert turns invisible air quality into a simple action.
implementation: Forward air-quality sensor readings to HEC; schedule every 15 minutes and alert when a room crosses a health threshold.
visualization: Table of rooms by particulates, carbon dioxide, and chemical levels.
grandmaExplanation: It watches the air inside your home and tells you when a room is stuffy or unhealthy and needs a window opened.
